name: Client-Side Image Compressor
shortDescription: Compress PNG, JPEG, and WebP files without uploading to external servers.
privacyNotice: 100% Client-Side. Images are rendered and encoded strictly on your device using HTML5 Canvas APIs.

howToUse.text: Drag and drop your JPEG, PNG, or WebP photo into the upload box or browse from your device.
Use the slider to set target compression quality (e.g. 70%-80% provides the optimal balance).
Preview the visual quality side-by-side with original and click Download.

features: Zero upload delay: processing begins instantly on your local GPU/CPU
Real-time visual comparison between original and compressed output
Calculates percentage of storage savings dynamically
Multi-format conversion to WebP, JPEG, and PNG
Works offline once the page has loaded
No file size caps imposed by remote server upload limits
limitations: Does not compress vector SVG files (use an SVG minifier for vectors)
Extremely high-resolution images (>40MP) may consume significant browser memory

faqs.q: Are my confidential photos uploaded to any server?
faqs.a: No. Modern HTML5 Canvas features allow us to read, scale, and compress images entirely on your computer or phone.

faqs.q: Which output format gives the smallest file size?
faqs.a: WebP usually delivers 25% to 35% better compression than traditional JPEG at equivalent perceived visual quality.

seoDescription: Compress and convert images online without uploading to any server. Fast, secure HTML5 Canvas compression for developers.
